ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a dominant low-intensity (black) central mass and roughly 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated on distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pixels occupy the majority of the medial surface; high-intensity white contiguous blocks and mottling are mapped to the distal tips and the perimeter of the trailing edge on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with a pronounced jagged protrusion on the far right lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave curve along the trailing edge boundary leading from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized high-contrast white pixel clusters near the median notch and distributed as speckling across the mid-region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating possible tissue loss or historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme binary-level pixel clipping between the foreground fluke and background, resulting in a high-contrast silhouette effect.
